story.summaryZh: 阿斯顿·马丁F1车队在USGP期间将I/AM活动带到奥斯汀，与当地社区共享赛车周仪式。

story.originalTitle: Austin, we see you. We know that there's more than one way to celebrate F1, and there's more than one side to Austin. That's why this #USGP, we're bri...
story.summaryEn:
Austin, we see you.
We know that there's more than one way to celebrate F1, and there's more than one side to Austin. That's why this #USGP, we're bringing I / AM to ATX to share in the race week rituals with local communities.
You. Us. Together.
Find out more: https://www.astonmartinf1.com/en-GB/news/feature/i-am-austin-for-the-new-generation-of-fans
detailZh:
奥斯汀，我们看到了你。
我们知道庆祝F1的方式不止一种，奥斯汀也有不止一面。这就是为什么在本届美国大奖赛，我们将I / AM带到ATX，与当地社区一起分享赛车周的仪式。
你。我们。一起。
了解更多信息：https://www.astonmartinf1.com/en-GB/news/feature/i-am-austin-for-the-new-generation-of-fans
detailEn:
Austin, we see you.
We know that there's more than one way to celebrate F1, and there's more than one side to Austin. That's why this #USGP, we're bringing I / AM to ATX to share in the race week rituals with local communities.
You. Us. Together.
Find out more: https://www.astonmartinf1.com/en-GB/news/feature/i-am-austin-for-the-new-generation-of-fans
